Running
Asia
South-eastern Asia
Laos

Highlights

Run through the historic heart of Luang Prabang, passing ornate golden temples and following the scenic banks of the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers.

Choose the distance that matches your goals, from the demanding 21 km Half Marathon and hilly 14 km course to the accessible, flat 7 km option.

Race with purpose while enjoying enthusiastic local support, knowing that participation helps provide essential healthcare for children in Northern Laos.

Official registration partner ofLuang Prabang Half Marathon

About the event

Challenge yourself in the Luang Prabang Half Marathon, a race that puts both body and spirit to the test while supporting children’s health in Northern Laos. Athletes can tackle the full 21 km Half Marathon, a course that weaves through historic streets, glides past golden temples, and hugs the winding banks of the Mekong and Nam Khan rivers—a route as scenic as it is demanding. For those transitioning to longer races, the 14 km run packs elevation changes and heritage views, striking a perfect balance of challenge and reward. The accessible 7 km distance is ideal for recovery days or as a tempo run, with a flat profile that lets you focus on pacing and community energy. Across all distances, expect enthusiastic support from local crowds and the opportunity to run with purpose, as every step helps deliver essential healthcare to children.
